reason: B is the stronger proposal because it uses a single controlled intervention under genuinely low fields and links measured strain relaxation to specific, falsifiable changes in ΔS(T) and hysteresis. Its cited evidence is only indirect and it inadequately addresses heat-transfer-limited cycle frequency, but A confounds annealing with substrate changes, treats fields up to 4 T as low, and makes the questionable general claim that reduced dimensions inherently worsen heat transfer.
